title: 🔥 “The Five Who Didn’t Burn: Why Many Are Anointed but Unready”
paragraphs: 🔥 “The Five Who Didn’t Burn: Why Many Are Anointed but Unready”

They were virgins.
They had lamps.
They were invited.
They were anointed.

But when the cry came —
🔥 they had no oil.

They lit the stage…
But didn’t last the delay.
They had passion…
But no endurance.
They preached…
But didn’t prepare.
And the door was shut.

Five were inside.
🔥 Five were locked out of eternity — forever.

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how can someone be chosen, anointed, and still miss Heaven?"

✅ ANSWER:
Because anointing isn’t endurance.
🔥 They were pure in name — but empty in oil.
They had the lamp of ministry…
But no intimacy to sustain the flame.

Jesus didn’t condemn them for wickedness —
📛 He denied them because He didn’t know them.

📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE (KJV):
Matthew 25:10–12
"…the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut... Verily I say unto you, I know you not."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-25-10_25-12/

💥 Read that again: “I KNOW YOU NOT.”
Not: “You sinned too much.”
Not: “You weren’t gifted.”
But: “You had no oil… and I don’t know you.”

THE CORE TRUTH — WHAT JESUS MEANT BY OIL, FOOLISH, AND “I NEVER KNEW YOU”
📖 Matthew 25:3 (KJV):
"They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them..."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-25-3/

🔹 Greek Word: “Foolish” = μωρός (moros)
💥 Meaning: Dull, spiritually lazy, without foresight.
🔥 Not rebellious — just careless and passive.

They weren’t evil.
They just didn’t prioritize what mattered most.

📖 Matthew 25:4 (KJV):
"But the wise took oil in their vessels..."

🔹 Greek Word: “Oil” = ἔλαιον (elaion)
💥 Literal: Olive oil used in lamps.
🔥 Symbolic: Intimacy, holiness, sustained fire.

This wasn’t just “charisma.”
This was the fuel of continual communion.
No oil = no flame = no entrance.

📖 Matthew 25:12 (KJV):
"Verily I say unto you, I know you not."

🔹 Greek Phrase: “Know you not” = οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς (ouk oida hymas)
💥 Meaning: “You are not recognized. We were never in covenant.”

🔥 Jesus didn’t reject them for delay.
He rejected them for absence of relationship.

They preached Him.
They waited for Him.
But they never knew Him.

📖 Luke 12:35 (KJV):
"Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;"
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-12-35/

💥 Lights burning = oil secured in advance.
🔥 Foolish virgins expected mercy in delay, not preparation in silence.
"Brother John, does this mean I could be saved, gifted, and still be shut out?"

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes — if your lamp has no oil when the cry comes.
🔥 Your title doesn’t carry you into the wedding.
🔥 Only intimacy-fed fire does.

You don’t enter because of identity.
You enter because of readiness.
⚡ Summary Strike:
Foolish = passive and careless, not wicked.
Oil = real intimacy, not just activity.
“I know you not” = No oil, no covenant, no entry.

🔥 This isn’t about having a lamp.
It’s about keeping it lit when Heaven calls.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — GOD’S DOORS DO SHUT
📖 Genesis 7:16 (KJV):
"And the Lord shut him in."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Genesis-7-16/

💥 Noah preached for 120 years.
They mocked. Delayed. Laughed.
But when the rain came —
🔥 God Himself shut the door.

No one else got in.
Not because of wickedness —
But because they waited too long.

📖 Exodus 12:30 (KJV):
"And there was a great cry in Egypt..."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Exodus-12-30/

💥 The door was marked in blood.
🔥 Those inside lived.
Those outside died.

There came a point of no return.
📛 Cry all you want after midnight —
The door will not reopen.

📖 Luke 13:25 (KJV):
"When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door..."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-13-25/

💥 Jesus warned that He Himself will rise and close the door.
🔥 Many will knock.
🔥 Many will cry.
But He will say: “I know you not.”

Same cry. Same judgment. Same consequence.
Different generation.

📖 Hebrews 12:17 (KJV):
"He found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Hebrews-12-17/

💥 Esau wanted it back.
But it was too late.

📛 There’s a difference between conviction and consequence.
And no amount of tears can unlock a door that God Himself has shut.
✝️ EARLY CHURCH TESTIMONY

✝️ Cyprian of Carthage (c. 250 AD):
"Let no one, when the trumpet sounds, seek to find his oil in another’s fire. Each must burn with what they’ve stored.”
📎 Source: On the Unity of the Church
Full Text: https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/050701.htm

✝️ Origen (c. 225 AD):
"The foolish virgins teach us that spiritual delay is not innocence. It is death, hiding in the form of waiting.”
📎 Source: Homilies on Matthew
Full Text: https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/1016.htm
"Brother John, what if I’ve assumed I had time, but never prepared?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then wake up now.
🔥 The midnight cry doesn’t come with a 5-minute warning.
🔥 If you’re hearing this — it’s mercy.
Once the Bridegroom comes…
📛 Mercy turns into judgment.

⚡ Summary Strike:
Every generation had a door.
And every door had a time limit.
🔥 Delay is not innocence.
🔥 Oil is not optional.
🔥 The cry will come.
Will your lamp still be burning?

RESURRECTION RESPONSE CODES — FOR THE ONES STILL BURNING
“I will not wait for the cry to start preparing — I’m filling my lamp now.”
“Oil is not a vibe — it’s proof I’ve been with Him.”
“Delay is not permission to sleep. It’s time to stock up.”
“If I borrow your flame, I’ll miss the door.”
“I’m not after fire moments — I want oil roots.”
“The wedding isn’t for the flashy. It’s for the ready.”
“I choose oil over applause. Obedience over opportunity. Jesus over delay.”
“My lamp will be full — even if I have to burn alone.”
“I won’t trade intimacy for appearance ever again.”
“They all looked like bridesmaids… but only five had oil.”
📢 DEPLOYMENT INSTRUCTIONS (FACEBOOK / SOCIAL):

🔥 Post 1–2 of the above codes with a bold caption:
👉 “I’m done carrying an empty lamp. I will burn when the cry comes. I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR.”

🔥 Use resurrection-fire hashtags:
#OilOrNothing
#GospelWarrior
#LampCheck
#BrideNotAsleep
#IAmReadyNow
📎 Invite others into the remnant fire group:
"Brother John, is posting these really warfare?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes — because every bold post pierces passive culture.
🔥 Every declaration draws a line in the oil.
🔥 You’re not just signaling conviction — you’re warning the sleepy.
But when the cry hits, they’ll remember who stayed burning.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The virgins all looked the same until the midnight cry.
🔥 Only the ones who stored oil entered in.

Make noise now —
🔥 So your silence isn’t eternal.

OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS — THE OIL MANDATE
📖 Exodus 27:20–21 (KJV):
"…they shall bring pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Exodus-27-20_27-21/

💥 God commanded continual oil — not occasional lighting.
🔥 The fire in the Tabernacle could never go out.
If it did… it was not just carelessness — it was sin.

📖 Leviticus 24:1–2 (KJV):
"Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light..."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Leviticus-24-1_24-2/

💥 No shortcuts.
🔥 No substitutions.
Only pure oil would keep the lamps lit before the Lord.
📛 No oil = no light = no access to presence.

📖 1 Samuel 3:3–4 (KJV):
"Ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the Lord... the Lord called Samuel."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/1-Samuel-3-3_3-4/

💥 When Eli’s leadership failed…
🔥 The lamp flickered out.
And then God called a boy with oil in his spirit.
📛 The oil’s failure always precedes God’s transfer.

📖 Zechariah 4:2–6 (KJV):
"I see a candlestick all of gold… and two olive trees... Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit..."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Zechariah-4-2_4-6/

💥 The candlestick = the Church.
The olive trees = the constant oil source.

🔥 God was showing: Without oil, there is no real power.
Not by gifting. Not by might.
Only by Spirit-fueled flame.
"Brother John, how does this Old Testament oil connect to the five foolish virgins?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Because every single time in Scripture —
🔥 No oil equals disqualification.
🔥 No oil equals missed encounters.
🔥 No oil equals divine replacement.

The foolish weren’t evil —
They were oil-less.
And in God’s eyes…
📛 That’s enough to shut the door.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The oil has always mattered.
From Levitical lamps to end-time bridesmaids —
🔥 The flame without oil dies in judgment.

The Old Testament warned.
Jesus echoed.
And now… the final cry is near.

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “I HAD THE LAMP… BUT NO OIL”
🧍‍♀️ Testimony: Lisa Q. — Worship Leader. Conference Speaker. Empty Lamp Carrier.

Lisa was “the anointed one.”
She led worship in packed rooms.
She cried on cue.
She could make an entire room fall under emotion…
But she hadn’t heard God in months.

She chalked it up to “the wilderness.”
But really—
🔥 She had no oil.

Prayer was rare.
Holiness was optional.
Intimacy was replaced with stage preparation.

Until one night—
Alone in her apartment, with no music, no camera, no people—
She heard a voice:
“You sing to crowds… but you haven’t burned before Me in years.”

She fell to the floor.
Not out of power—
But out of shame.

She tried to stir it up again…
🔥 But there was nothing left.
No tears.
No words.
No intimacy.

That’s when she repented.
Not for sin—
But for surviving on stage fire with an empty inner altar.

She disappeared for six months.
No posts. No gigs.
Just rebuilding the private oil flow.

Now she sings again—
But only in living rooms and living altars.
🔥 The lights are off.
🔥 The shoes are off.
🔥 The fire is real.
Her message?

“Don’t wait for the cry to realize you’re hollow.
If your gift still works, but your oil is gone…
That’s not grace. That’s God waiting.”
"Brother John, what if I’ve performed like Lisa — but felt the emptiness?"

✅ Direct Answer:
Then you still have time to rebuild.
🔥 But don’t go back to the platform until the oil is real again.
You don’t need another microphone.
📛 You need a midnight cry in secret — that crushes you back into oil.

⚡ Summary Strike:
Lisa was known by the crowd.
But Heaven said:
🔥 “I know you not… until you burn for Me alone.”

Don’t fake the flame.
🔥 Return to the oil.

FINAL CHALLENGE — DON’T WAIT FOR THE CRY TO START POURING OIL
📖 Matthew 25:6 (KJV):
"And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-25-6/

💥 All ten virgins heard the cry.
All ten woke up.
🔥 But only five were ready.

This was not about alertness.
This was about prior preparation.
📛 REALITY CHECK:

✔️ You may still look anointed.
✔️ You may still know Scripture.
✔️ You may still post fire content.

But if your lamp is dry—
🔥 The door will not recognize you.

Jesus will not open for activity.
🔥 He opens for oil.

📖 Song of Solomon 5:6 (KJV):
"I opened to my beloved... but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone..."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Song-Of-Solomon-5-6/

💥 She delayed at the door.
She got distracted.
And when she opened…
🔥 It was too late.

The Bridegroom was gone.
📛 The romance was over.
💭 HEAVEN’S FINAL QUESTIONS:

Are you singing… with no oil?
Are you preaching… with no secret place?
Are you “waiting”… while your lamp is empty?

Because when the cry hits —
You won’t have time to borrow.
You won’t have time to learn intimacy.

🔥 You’ll either have oil…
Or you’ll have regret.
"Brother John, is it too late for me if I’ve delayed this long?"

✅ Direct Answer:
If you’re reading this — you still have time.
But the window is narrowing.
🔥 God is raising a remnant with full lamps.
If you don’t refill now…
📛 You may recognize the cry—
But be locked out of the wedding.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The cry is not an invitation to prepare.
🔥 It’s the signal that preparation time is over.

Don’t sleep another day with an empty lamp.
🔥 Get oil… or be denied.

FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE — WHO STORES OIL?
📖 Matthew 25:2–4 (KJV):
"And five of them were wise, and five were foolish..."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-25-2_25-4/

They all looked the part.
They all waited in the right place.
But only the wise were preparing—
🔥 while the foolish were assuming.
⚠️ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:

❌ “God understands my season.”
❌ “I’ll get serious when things settle.”
❌ “I still feel anointed—I must be fine.”
❌ “I’ll borrow someone else’s flame if I have to.”

📛 Result:
They depend on borrowed intimacy.
They delay repentance.
They’re shocked when the door won’t open.
🔥 They wake up… just in time to be locked out.
✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:

✔️ “Oil is my responsibility.”
✔️ “The cry is coming — I must be ready now.”
✔️ “I don’t want to look holy. I want to burn holy.”
✔️ “Let me pay the price for oil in private before the public shutout begins.”

🔥 Result:
They prepare before pressure.
They pray before the panic.
They have oil when others are scrambling for flame.

📖 Proverbs 22:3 (KJV):
"A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Proverbs-22-3/

💥 The wise prepare when it’s still silent.
📛 The foolish wait until they hear footsteps—
But by then, it’s too late.
"Brother John, I’ve been the fool. Can I still become wise?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes. But only if you move now.
🔥 Wisdom isn’t about brilliance.
🔥 It’s about urgency in the Spirit.

If you still care—
Then you still have time to bow, burn, and be ready.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The Church is full of lamps.
But Heaven is counting oil.

🔥 The wise will enter.
📛 The fools will knock too late.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — WOULD YOU BE IN THE ROOM… OR OUTSIDE THE DOOR?
📖 Matthew 25:11–12 (KJV):
"Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us. But he answered... Verily I say unto you, I know you not."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-25-11_25-12/

💥 They didn’t knock on the wrong door.
They weren’t in the wrong religion.
🔥 They came too late…
And were never known.

📖 Matthew 7:22–23 (KJV):
"Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord... and then will I profess unto them, I never knew you."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-7-22_7-23/

💥 They had the language.
They had the miracles.
🔥 They had the lamp…
But no oil.

And Jesus didn’t say, “You failed.”
He said: “I never knew you.”

📖 Revelation 3:1 (KJV):
"Thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-3-1/

💥 You can have a ministry, a reputation, and even fire songs…
🔥 And still be oil-less in Heaven’s registry.

The Groom is not impressed by your résumé.
📛 He’s looking for flame-fed intimacy.

💭 ETERNITY QUESTION:
If tonight was the cry—
Would you be one of the five inside…
🔥 Or one of the five begging at a sealed door?

Would Jesus say:
“Welcome, my beloved…”
Or:
“I know you not.”
"Brother John, I’ve had the lamp for years… but I’m terrified I have no oil.”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then don’t delay one more day.
🔥 Stop serving from fumes.
🔥 Stop depending on hype.
🔥 Stop assuming grace without surrender.

Tonight could be your last night.
And the Groom won’t ask how you looked.
📛 He’ll ask: “Did you burn for Me?”

⚡ Summary Strike:
You don’t get in because you started with a lamp.
🔥 You get in because you kept it burning until the door opened.

If you died tonight…
🔥 Would you walk in?
📛 Or weep outside?

SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — HOW HELL PREVENTS YOU FROM FILLING YOUR LAMP
👿 1. “You Have Time” Sedation
“Don’t be dramatic. Jesus isn’t coming yet.”

💀 Truth:
📛 Delay doesn’t mean safety.
🔥 It means testing.

The enemy lulls you to sleep with timing lies —
So you’ll be unready when the cry breaks.
👿 2. “Borrow Someone Else’s Oil” Trap
“Just follow your favorite preacher. Just go to conferences.”

💀 Truth:
🔥 You can’t borrow intimacy.
You can’t siphon someone else’s surrender.
The oil must be purchased in private — not borrowed in panic.
👿 3. “Activity Equals Preparedness” Illusion
“You’re serving, posting, ministering — you’re good!”

💀 Truth:
📛 The foolish virgins had lamps.
🔥 They just didn’t have ongoing fire.

Busyness ≠ readiness.
Crowds ≠ covenant.
Ministry ≠ marriage.
👿 4. “God Is Too Loving to Lock You Out” Lie
“He would never close the door on someone who tried.”

💀 Truth:
🔥 God is love — but He is also the Bridegroom.
And the wedding has a schedule.

He warned us.
He delayed on purpose.
📛 But eventually… the door shuts.
👿 5. “You’ll Recognize the Cry in Time” Confidence Game
“You’ll know when it’s close. You’ll feel it.”

💀 Truth:
🔥 The cry comes at midnight —
When it’s dark.
When it’s sudden.
When only oil can show the way.

📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 (KJV):
"And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Corinthians-11-14/

💥 Satan doesn’t show up as sin.
🔥 He shows up as false fire — emotional hype that masks intimacy starvation.
"Brother John, what if I’ve believed these lies?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then you expose them now.
🔥 Don’t reason with deception — rebuke it.
🔥 Don’t blend with delay — burn against it.
🔥 Don’t admire others’ lamps — fill your own.

You don’t win by being louder.
You win by being filled when it’s silent.

⚡ Summary Strike:
Hell doesn’t need to take your lamp.
🔥 It just needs you to forget the oil.

And by the time you realize it…
📛 The door will already be closing.

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — FILL ME AGAIN, AND KEEP ME BURNING
📢 DECLARE THIS OUT LOUD — LET ANGELS RECORD AND HELL TREMBLE.

“Jesus,
I have carried a lamp… but let it run dry.
I have delayed obedience.
I have trusted gifting instead of intimacy.
I have looked the part,
But I have not burned for You like I used to.
Forgive me.

I renounce delay.
I renounce false fire.
I renounce every excuse that kept me from getting oil.

From this moment, I will not sleep without intimacy.
I will not serve without surrender.
I will not preach without prayer.
I will not worship without weeping.

If I must disappear to fill my vessel — so be it.
If I must be forgotten to stay burning — let them forget me.
But I will have oil when You call.

Let my lamp burn when others flicker out.
Let me be found ready — not just emotional.
Let me be known — not just seen.

Jesus, I want to be in the wedding…
Not outside the door I assumed would wait for me.
From this day forward…

🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR.
🔥 I AM A WISE VIRGIN.
🔥 I AM OIL-FILLED AND FIRE-KEPT.

Until the cry comes,
I will stay burning.

In Jesus’ holy name,
Amen.”
👉 “I renounce delay. I’m done performing empty. I choose oil, not image. I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR.”
🔥 Tag others and invite them to fill their lamps here:
"Brother John, how do I maintain this fire?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Oil isn’t stored in hype.
🔥 It’s stored in hidden obedience, consistent surrender, and ruthless pruning.
The cry is coming.
Stay burning.

⚡ Summary Strike:
You were not born for the outer court.
🔥 You were born to walk into the wedding.
And now—your lamp is lit again.

HOLY SPIRIT EMPOWERMENT DECREE — FILL MY VESSEL, NOT MY EGO
📢 DECLARE THIS OUT LOUD — LET THE OIL FLOW AND THE FLAME BE SEALED.

“Holy Spirit,
I do not ask for more stage.
I ask for more surrender.
I don’t want to shine — I want to last.
I don’t want borrowed fire — I want purchased oil.

I lay down every drop of hype.
Every trace of mixture.
Every performance that masked my emptiness.
Now, fill me again.

Not for power.
But for purity.

Not to impress.
But to endure.

Not to be followed.
But to be faithful.

Let me burn through silence.
Let me burn through delay.
Let me burn through boredom, obscurity, and pruning.

I will not trade intimacy for influence again.
I will not trade depth for reach.
I will not trade oil for applause.

🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR — not because I preach,
But because I carry oil no one sees.

Holy Spirit, fill me.
Seal me.
Ignite me.
Keep me burning — until the Bridegroom calls.

In Jesus’ holy name,
Amen.”
🕊 POST-DECREE MISSION:

Find a hidden place today. 1 hour. No music. No words.
Say: “Holy Spirit, teach me how to store oil again.”
Write what you hear.

📖 Meditate on Matthew 25:13 (KJV):
"Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh."
URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-25-13/
"Brother John, what if I get weary again in this oil walk?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then come back to the secret place before the flicker fades.
🔥 The wise don’t feel perfect —
They just keep returning for more oil.

This fire is not built in public.
📛 It’s kept alive in the midnight room.

⚡ Summary Strike:
Your lamp is no longer a prop.
🔥 It’s a covenant torch… sealed with oil and carried to the end.

WARFARE ASSIGNMENT — THE OIL IS NOT FOR SHOW, IT’S FOR SURVIVAL
🛡 1. Set a Lamp Check Alarm (Daily Reminder)
⏰ Every evening, set an alarm titled:
“Lamp Check — Am I burning or pretending?”
📝 When it rings, stop and ask:
Did I pray today with depth?
Did I obey what He whispered yesterday?
Am I fueled or just moving?

🔥 The foolish wait for a cry.
The wise do daily oil inspections.
📖 2. Read Matthew 25:1–13 Daily for 5 Days

Write this at the top of the page:
📝 “I don’t want to be late. I don’t want to be locked out.”

📎 Verse link:
👉 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-25-1_25-13/
🔥 Ask the Holy Spirit to highlight a new warning or revelation each day.
📢 3. Post This on Facebook to Wake Others:
👉 “I’ve carried a lamp long enough. Now I want oil. I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR. Fill your vessel before it’s too late.”

#FillYourLamp
#OilOverImage
#MidnightCryIsComing
#GospelWarrior
#WiseVirginRemnant
📎 Invite others to the Remnant Group:
🕊 4. Teach This Scroll to One Other Person (Offline)

🔥 Find one soul and walk them through the 5-fool / 5-wise divide.
Make them read it for themselves.
Help them respond in private before the public cry comes.
⚔️ 5. Fast One Comfort That Weakens Oil Flow
Pick 1 of these this week:
1 meal a day
All screens after 9PM
All music but worship
Social media detox
No talking during morning prayer

🔥 Oil isn’t cheap.
It flows where flesh dies.
"Brother John, what if no one around me is preparing like this?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then you are being called as a midnight voice.
🔥 Don’t wait for others to get serious.
Be the one who sounds the cry.
📛 Even if you burn alone — it’s better than knocking too late.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The oil must be guarded.
The fire must be fed.
The assignment must be obeyed — before the sky splits.
